VI.description: Open a .lvproj in THIS application instance and open its window\2C so it can become the ACTIVE project NI's class providers look up.\0A\0AWHY IT EXISTS. The pylabview backend reaches LabVIEW over ActiveX\2C not through NI's OpenFile RPC\3B run that way this VI executes in LabVIEW's main application instance\2C which is the IDE's - so the project it opens is the one Project\3AActive Project answers.\0A\0AWHY THE WINDOW. NI's class providers answer Error 1055 without an ACTIVE project\2C and the gRPC route needs its project in front for that. Measured 2026-10-10 over ActiveX\3A opened with its window\2C the project was the active one at once\2C with no fronting. Whether it would be without Open Window is not measured. A caller still checks with lvai_active_project.

Control.description: Absolute path of the .lvproj to open.
